articles.webHeadline: He Transformed His Spanish Hometown. Did He Also Spoil It?
articles.printHeadline: He’s Málaga’s Savior to Some. To Others, He’s Its Spoiler.
articles.abstract: Francisco de la Torre, the mayor of Málaga, is credited with turning the once drab port into a culture and tech hub. Critics say he’s also destroyed the city’s soul.

articles.webHeadline: Trump Names Will Scharf as White House Counsel
articles.printHeadline: President Names Scharf as His White House Counsel
articles.abstract: The president said Mr. Scharf, a deeply conservative lawyer and the current staff secretary, would replace David Warrington in early September.

articles.webHeadline: Lake Mead, the Nation’s Largest Reservoir, Is Smaller Than Ever
articles.printHeadline: Nation’s Largest Reservoir Has Dropped to New Low
articles.abstract: Water levels in the reservoir, which sits behind the Hoover Dam, are at record lows. A continued drop would imperil water supplies for millions of people and cut electricity from the dam.
